answer: Keeping a false camel costs 14,800 and a year of feeding it in hiding, and the fraud still fails at the first oasis gate. Every camel is branded at birth and the register holds the brand of each beast in the caravan, and the gatekeeper reads the brand against the book before the camel may drink. A echo camel bought from a dealer fails the register: at the mesa of the brand the burn must match the caravan's own iron, and the vertex entry in the register is checked at every gate, so a strange camel is turned away.
